# Historical datasets

<!-- generated by tools/export_schemas.py from sim/history.py; do not edit -->

The history is a set of Parquet tables. Service hours are 06:00-23:59, local time
(Europe/Madrid). Read them through the HTTP API (`/v1/history/...`, `/v1/sql`,
`/v1/datasets/{table}/files` for direct Parquet downloads) or the MCP server
(`run_sql`, `line_hourly`, ...). See [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml) and [mcp.md](mcp.md).

Every table is partitioned: always filter on the partition column in SQL
(`WHERE month BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-03'` or `WHERE dt = '2026-10-09'`), it is
what keeps queries fast and within the scan limit.

## `line_hourly`

One row per service hour, line and direction. Covers the whole history (years).

Partition column: `month` (string, `YYYY-MM`).

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | date | Service date (local time, Europe/Madrid) |
| `hour` | tinyint | Hour of day 0-23 (local time) |
| `line_id` | string | EMT line id |
| `direction` | tinyint | 0 outbound, 1 inbound |
| `trips` | int | Trips that reached the end of the leg in this hour |
| `boardings` | int | Passengers who boarded |
| `alightings` | int | Passengers who got off |
| `avg_load` | double | Mean passengers / nominal capacity over buses in service (can exceed 1) |
| `max_load` | double | Highest passengers / nominal capacity seen |
| `avg_trip_minutes` | double | Mean duration of the trips counted in `trips` (null if none) |
| `avg_wait_minutes` | double | Estimated mean wait at stops (half the observed headway) |

## `stop_hourly`

One row per service hour and stop, all lines together. Covers the whole history.

Partition column: `month` (string, `YYYY-MM`).

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | date | Service date (local time) |
| `hour` | tinyint | Hour of day 0-23 (local time) |
| `stop_id` | string | EMT stop code |
| `boardings` | int | Passengers who boarded at the stop, all lines |
| `alightings` | int | Passengers who got off at the stop, all lines |
| `avg_waiting` | double | Mean people waiting at the stop |
| `max_waiting` | int | Most people waiting at the stop |
| `bus_calls` | int | Bus calls at the stop |

## `stop_calls`

One row each time a bus calls at a stop. Last days of history plus the live day.

Partition column: `dt` (string, `YYYY-MM-DD`).

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ts` | timestamp | Time the bus reached the stop (local time) |
| `bus_id` | string | Bus id: <line>-<n> |
| `line_id` | string | EMT line id |
| `direction` | tinyint | Leg the bus was on when arriving: 0 outbound, 1 inbound |
| `stop_id` | string | EMT stop code |
| `terminal` | boolean | End of a leg: everyone got off |
| `alighted` | int | Passengers who got off |
| `boarded` | int | Passengers who boarded |
| `passengers_after` | int | Passengers on board when leaving |
| `left_behind` | int | People still waiting for this line and direction (bus full) |

## `bus_positions`

Every bus every 30 seconds. Last days of history plus the live day.

Partition column: `dt` (string, `YYYY-MM-DD`).

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ts` | timestamp | Sample time (local time) |
| `bus_id` | string | Bus id |
| `line_id` | string | EMT line id |
| `direction` | tinyint | 0 outbound, 1 inbound |
| `lat` | double | Latitude (WGS84) |
| `lon` | double | Longitude (WGS84) |
| `passengers` | int | Passengers on board |
| `state` | string | driving or dwelling |
| `next_stop_id` | string | Next stop the bus will call at |

## Example queries

```sql
-- Average rush-hour load per line in a quarter
SELECT line_id, round(avg(avg_load), 3) AS load
FROM line_hourly
WHERE month BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-03' AND hour IN (8, 18) AND day_of_week(date) <= 5
GROUP BY line_id ORDER BY load DESC;

-- Days with no service at all
SELECT date, sum(trips) AS trips FROM line_hourly
WHERE month BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2026-12' GROUP BY date HAVING sum(trips) = 0 ORDER BY date;

-- Unusual evening crowds at a stop
SELECT date, hour, boardings FROM stop_hourly
WHERE month >= '2025-01' AND stop_id = '72' AND hour >= 18 ORDER BY boardings DESC LIMIT 20;
```
